title: Matrix Products with @
learning_objectives: Multiply matrices and matrix–vector pairs with the @ operator
Predict result shapes and catch mismatches before multiplying
Score a whole batch of examples with one product
Verify @ against the triple loop from Mathematics
entry_point: matmul_loops(A, B); matmul(A, B); batch_scores(X, w, b); gram(X)
hints: Loops: for each i (rows of A) and j (columns of B), sum `A[i][k] * B[k][j]` over k.
`if A.shape[1] != B.shape[0]: raise ValueError(f"cannot multiply {A.shape} by {B.shape}")`.
`np.asarray(X, dtype=float) @ np.asarray(w, dtype=float) + b`; `X @ X.T` for the Gram matrix.

failure_feedback.advice: Entry (i, j) is the sum over k of A[i][k] * B[k][j].
Check `A.shape[1] != B.shape[0]` and include both shapes in the message.
Compute `X @ w + b` with float arrays.
The Gram matrix is `X @ X.T`, shape (rows, rows).
